title: cassia littoralis
intro: Cassia littoralis, commonly known as Coast Cassia, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cassia littoralis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and combat oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which work together to exhibit their medicinal effects.
